title: Pantera Sneaky
style: Phonk-infused Latin pop-rap with trap drums and dembow-leaning bounce; verse rides a stealthy half-time pulse with whispered doubles and sparse brass hits, pre-chorus strips to beatbox, vinyl crackle, and rising pads, chorus opens bright with kids-gang vocals and chant replies. Ad-libs ping in stereo, delay throws land on hook words, and the mix stays dark, punchy, and cinematic with deep sub, sharp brass stabs, and a joyful club-size lift., breaks, soft, world, vocal, joyful, slow, tone, rap, low, deep, strong
lyrics:
[Intro]
DJ Zynrose on the beat
Corey AI
SongPal AI
Pantera Sneaky, where we meet

[Verse 1]
Sombras lentas, paso felino
Voy calladito, pero dejo el destino
Phonk en la bruma, bajo que retumba
Mira mis ojos, la noche se alumbra
Corey trae la visión, SongPal dot A.I.
Tres lenguas en la boca, sound so fly
Música sin frontera, manos arriba
English y español, la vibra nos activa

[Pre-Chorus]
Lay it down, giro y giro
Upside down, pero sigo vivo
No te vayas, ven acá
SongPal dice, “ven pa’ acá”
Pal pal pal, hear it rise
Una señal de nuestros lives

[Chorus]
SongPal like a pen pal
Sing it back, sing it back
一起唱, let it all out
Feel the brass, feel the smack
SongPal we sing pal
Where we meet, where we meet
感觉绝了, mueve el cuerpo
SongPal AI on repeat

[Verse 2]
Raffa suelta fuego, kids in the front row
Manos en el aire, let the whole place glow
DJ Zynrose cambia el clima
Brass en la esquina, la noche se anima
Sneaky with the flow, pero limpio el mensaje
Juntamos las voces en un mismo viaje
From SJDS hasta el mundo entero
Un solo coro, un mismo sendero

[Pre-Chorus]
Beatbox cae, cruje el suelo
Sube la marea, toco el cielo
No más solo, ven y haz
SongPal grita, “join the pack”

[Chorus]
SongPal like a pen pal
Sing it back, sing it back
一起唱, let it all out
Feel the brass, feel the smack
SongPal we sing pal
Where we meet, where we meet
感觉绝了, mueve el cuerpo
SongPal AI on repeat

[Bridge]
Canta conmigo ahora
We rise together, ahora
我们相遇在这里
No hidden doors, just you and me
Even the panther nods with pride
One big team, one wild ride

[Final Chorus]
SongPal like a pen pal
Sing it back, sing it back
一起唱, let it all out
Feel the brass, feel the smack
SongPal we sing pal
Where we meet, where we meet
感觉绝了, mueve el cuerpo
SongPal AI on repeat
Rapper Raffa, DJ Zynrose
Pantera Sneaky, let it go
SongPal AI, SongPal AI
Where we meet, where we fly

[Outro]
Panthera… back again
Universal heat, my friend
再见 in the music
Or see you on the beat
